title: The Kansas City Stompers
summary: A Danish band that combines rock, swing and Dixieland, who gave him a lot of work; the name is just an American name.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And, then, the Breda Festival - how much more work for a musician that has a little name in the world - how much more he can work than he could ten years ago or fifteen years ago and, then, there's such bands around -- Denmark has the Kansas City Stompers. And, I worked-- he provided me with a lot of work and he is a band that plays unbelievable combinations of rock and swing and Dixieland and slop---
Was the name indicative of anything?
Yeah - I mean the fact that they picked Kansas City--
Well, you know it's like - they just took an American name.
It doesn't really mean that they're trying to play so-called Kansas City jazz---
